name: WeatherAPI
label: WeatherAPI
description: WeatherAPI official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: current, forecast, history, astronomy, timezone, sports. Docs: https://www.weatherapi.com/docs/. WeatherAPI.com terms. Query param key. Commercial redistribution licensed. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One WeatherAPI request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"current"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: current | forecast | history | astronomy | timezone | sports. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'current'.

schema.label: alerts
schema.description: Weather alerts. EXACT: yes | no. forecast.

schema.label: aqi
schema.description: Air quality. EXACT: yes | no. current / forecast.

schema.label: dt
schema.description: Date yyyy-MM-dd for history / astronomy. Required on history. Example: 2026-01-01.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Query: city, lat,lon, US zip, UK postcode, or IP. Required. Example: London or 48.8567,2.3508.

schema.label: lang
schema.description: Condition text language. current/forecast/history. Example: es.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: current, forecast, history, astronomy, timezone, sports.

configurationParameters.label: Key
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 20. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
